newsitem.title: UK: Dumped U.S. model dishes dirt on Dodi.
newsitem.headline: Dumped U.S. model dishes dirt on Dodi.

text.p: The American model who alleges she was ditched by Dodi Al Fayed in favour of Princess Diana opened her heart to a British newspaper on Monday, saying her former lover was a dud in bed.

With the bizarre saga of the princess and the playboy showing no sign of losing its fascination for the British press, Kelly Fisher dished the dirt on the heir to the Harrods empire who is said to have won the affection of one of the world's most glamorous women.
"Dodi isn't a great lover. He doesn't know how to pleasure a woman," Fisher, 30, was quoted as telling the Sun in an exclusive interview.

"He wasn't into foreplay at all. I always had to make the first move. At various points in our relationship I tried to drop subtle hints about ways to make our love life more satisfying. But he didn't seem interested," she added.

Fisher maintained, however, she was deeply in love with Al Fayed, son of the Egyptian businessman Mohamed Al Fayed, and that the pair were engaged to be married at the time he was romancing Princess Diana on board a yacht in the Mediterranean last month.

"Our relationship wasn't based on sex...I loved him for his personality and for his kindness," said Fisher, who also recounted how Al Fayed had showered her with roses, teddy bears and jewellery and paid the rent on her California apartment.
Al Fayed, 41, denies he promised to marry Fisher and is contesting a breach of contract lawsuit brought by her in Los Angeles.
As Fisher's story hit the news-stands, Diana was on a cruise of the Greek islands pursued by paparazzi photographers convinced that another tryst was planned there with Al Fayed.
British public relations consultant Max Clifford, who says he is advising Al Fayed, told the Daily Mirror newspaper a rendezvous in Greece was likely.
"Dodi is hoping to go over there in the week. He and Diana want to spend as much time as possible together.
"It's a holiday romance. As to where it goes...who knows?" Clifford said.
The Mirror said that at least another five of Al Fayed's former girlfriends were planning to talk to the media about him.
But Clifford said that Diana, who was divorced from heir to the throne Prince Charles only a year ago, was relaxed about his past.
"Diana knew all about Dodi's past. She's known him for 10 years, they've been friends for a year and their friendship turned to romance two weeks ago.
"They have talked about his other girlfriends and expected some to come out of the woodwork," Clifford said.
